_meta.description: Maharashtra district & sessions court formatting rules — drives cause-title, party designations, prayer language, verification format
_meta.change_protocol: CLO sign-off required for any change. Vishal raises Jira tickets to Ajay for additions; never edits unilaterally.

designation: IN THE COURT OF DISTRICT & SESSIONS JUDGE
jurisdictionNote: District-level criminal and civil courts in Maharashtra. Sessions courts try offences punishable with imprisonment exceeding 7 years. District courts handle civil suits, execution proceedings, and appeals from subordinate courts. Mumbai City Civil & Sessions Court and Mumbai Suburban (Dindoshi) operate under the Bombay City Civil Court Act, 1948 and the Code of Civil Procedure as locally adapted.

party_designation.state: State of Maharashtra through the Principal Secretary, Home Department, Government of Maharashtra, Mumbai

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the applicant shall, as in duty bound, ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby solemnly affirm and declare that the contents of the above application from paragraph ___ to paragraph ___ are true to my personal knowledge and the contents of paragraphs ___ to ___ are believed to be true on the basis of information received and legal advice tendered, which I believe to be true. Nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Solemnly affirmed at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: Bail applications under S.483 BNSS must disclose any earlier rejection by the Magistrate or any co-ordinate court.
Anticipatory bail applications (S.482 BNSS) must be accompanied by an affidavit and a certified copy of the FIR.
Vakalatnama in Form prescribed under the Bombay High Court (Original Side) Rules / Civil Manual to be filed at the first instance with a court-fee stamp of Rs. 5.
All civil pleadings to be paginated, indexed and accompanied by a list of documents under Order VII / Order VIII CPC.
Marathi translation may be insisted upon by the Court for documents in English where parties are not conversant; cf. Bombay Court Fees Act and Maharashtra Civil Manual.
In Mumbai City Civil & Sessions Court, plaints are valued under the Bombay City Civil Court Act, 1948; pecuniary jurisdiction periodically revised by State Govt. notification.
Service of summons in Mumbai is governed by the local Civil Manual; bailiff service is supplemented by registered post AD.
Atrocities (SC/ST) cases, POCSO cases and NDPS cases are tried by designated Special Courts notified by the State Government.
e_filing_note: e-Filing is operational at Mumbai City Civil & Sessions Court and select district HQs via the eCourts portal; not yet mandatory state-wide.
